results.fact: Approach mileage/gain figures citing the wrong route's trailhead (Scatter Lake)
results.evidence: Still real: partner_requirements quotes the south-side Scatter Lake figures (~11 mi RT / 5,200 ft) beside a Wolf Creek figure, and approachTime mixes both. These figures cannot be replaced until the row's approach is rebuilt around the Wolf Creek/Gardner Meadows line (see the STRUCTURAL item below). results.fact: Which approach/trailhead the North Ridge uses (North Creek Trail #413 + mine trail vs Wolf Creek/Gardner Meadows; Trailhead waypoint named Scatter Creek at 3,150 ft)
results.correct_value: Wolf Creek Trailhead -> Gardner Meadows -> tarn below the ridge -> spur ridge -> north ridge past the old mine -> summit
results.evidence: STRUCTURAL: rebuild the row around the Wolf Creek / Gardner Meadows approach (decision rule 3: most documented line in current use). Two independent trip reports climb the north ridge this way: a July 2020 report (Wolf Creek trail ~10 mi to Gardner Meadows, off-trail past Abernathy Lake to the tarn below the ridge, spur ridge with a few class 3 moves to the main ridge, boot path through old mining remains, class 2/3 to the summit) and a separate multi-peak report from Wolf Creek via Gardner Meadows, the abandoned mine trail and tarn. The North Creek Trail #413 mine-trail approach is described by only one source (the peak's main route page). What should change: move the Trailhead waypoint (currently named 'Scatter Creek Trailhead' with a North Creek note, 3,150 ft) to the Wolf Creek Trailhead; rewrite approach, approach_logistics.trailhead/trailheadDirection, itinerary day 1, timing.sectionBreakdown note, pro_tips[0] ('via the Twisp River side') and partner_requirements to the Gardner Meadows line; demote the North Creek text to an approach_variants alternative or drop it. Needs pin moves and a whole-row rewrite, which the patch format cannot express.

results.fact: Descent method: rappels/itinerary say descend via the North Ridge (1 rappel), but descent/descent_text/bail describe reversing the South Ridge itself
results.evidence: Third pass searched again for any account of the Aiguille de l'M South Ridge (trip reports, Boston Basin climber logs, guide pages); every hit covers only the North Ridge (one ~40 ft rappel then reverse that ridge) or the photo caption naming the two ridges. The single route listing that addresses the South Ridge descent says descend via the North Ridge; no second source exists, so the row's 2-2 split is not patched.

results.fact: Total elevation gain for the traverse (gain_ft 2900 is only the trail gain to Easy Pass)
results.evidence: Decision rule 4: gain_ft 2,900 is provably wrong as a whole-outing total and no single sourced replacement exists. The row's own breakdown gives ~2,885 ft for the Easy Pass trail alone. A published car-to-car definition of the four-summit traverse from the Easy Pass Trailhead gives 21.15 mi and 12,800 ft; a club listing for the four-peak traverse gives 8,000 ft / 20 mi; a two-day party that reached only Mesahchie and Katsuk logged 14.83 mi and 6,336 ft. Every source is more than double 2,900 but they disagree with each other, so gain_ft is set to null rather than to any of them.

patches.fact: Total elevation gain for the traverse (gain_ft 2900 is only the trail gain to Easy Pass)

results.fact: dist_km 24 (14.9 mi) shown as the one-way approach
results.evidence: dist_km 24 km (~15 mi) renders as 'Approach (one way)', but Easy Pass is 3.4-3.6 mi from the trailhead and the high camp only a few miles beyond; 15 mi matches round-trip figures for partial traverses (one report 14.83 mi RT). results.fact: access.closures is null while the bivy entries say the Rachel Lake trailhead / Box Canyon road were inside a 2026 wildfire closure
results.evidence: The current Forest Service order (06-17-03-2026-44, effective 18 Sep 2026 through 31 Oct 2026) still lists Rachel Lake Trail 1313, Rachel Lake Trailhead and road 4930 as closed. But a news report updated 21-24 Sep 2026 says the Three Queens closure orders were lifted in parts of the Cle Elum Ranger District without naming which, so the two sources do not agree on the current state. A time-bound closure should be written from a confirmed current order; nothing is patched.

results.fact: Whole-outing gain/loss: gain_ft 6257 vs loss_ft 6157 on an out-and-back, with day 2 not counting the re-climb over Fourth Creek Pass
results.evidence: New sources this pass: a single-day ascent from the Beverly Creek trailhead gives c.15 mi round trip but only the net 4,853 ft rise, and an archived route page gives the Beverly/Fourth Creek approach as about 5.1 mi with ~1,800 ft up to Fourth Creek Pass and ~1,200 ft down to Ingalls Creek (to be re-climbed on return). Neither states a car-to-car gain, and the only stated figures (7,400 ft; ~7,550 ft assembled from one report's day figures) are not two agreeing stated totals. New day-2 values would have to be computed, so nothing is patched.

results.fact: Pitch count: 8 (pitches field / prose) vs 6 (approach text and pitch_detail rows)
results.evidence: Depends on the STRUCTURAL item below. 8 pitches is the published count for the Southeast Ridge (the row's name, beta, rappels); the six pitch_detail rows and the '6 pitches' in partner_requirements and seasonal_hazards describe the col-side East Ridge. No second full description of the Southeast Ridge was found this pass (archived climber's log has only South Route and NE Couloir entries), so the breakdown cannot be rebuilt.

results.fact: Route name 'Southeast Ridge' vs prose describing the 'East Ridge' from the Argonaut-Colchuck col
results.evidence: STRUCTURAL: the row fuses two routes. name, face, pitches (8), beta and rappels describe the Southeast Ridge (II 5.6, 8 pitches to the SE spire, two single or one double rappel into the notch), which two listings name as a separate route; pitch_detail (starts 'From the Argonaut-Colchuck col'), descent_text ('reversing the East Ridge ... notch just west of the lone gendarme'), rappel_detail (traverse toward the east gully) and the '6 pitches' text describe the East Ridge from the col, which has its own route page. What should change: either rename the row to the col-side East Ridge and move the Southeast Ridge facts (8 pitches, SE spire, notch rappels) to a separate row, or replace pitch_detail/descent_text/rappel_detail with a Southeast Ridge description once one can be read in full. Needs a rename or a rebuilt breakdown, which the patch format cannot express.

results.fact: dist_km (4.5 km) is the camp-to-Austera leg, not the one-way approach
results.evidence: New figures this pass are all per-leg or multi-peak: a club route profile gives trailhead to Klawatti Col 7-9 hr / 5,600 ft and col to Austera 2 hr / 530 ft (no miles); a winter trip gives 16 mi / 9,000 ft for Klawatti plus Austera together.
